checks.what: Swedish-empire loss 1617/3 to tsardom-of-russia of Ingria (Leningrad oblast, 388 cells) minus Cliopatria's Swedish 1619 shape: 293 cells (74,100 km2) resolved. Stolbovo page: 'The meeting took place on 9 March [O.S. 27 February] 1617'; 'Sweden gained the province of Kexholm in Karelia and the province of Ingria - including the fortress of Noteborg'; 'Novgorod and other Swedish territorial gains during the war would be returned to Russia'. Trial against an empty patch, current dossiers: Russia keeps 206 cells east of the province (Tikhvin, Staraya Ladoga, Volkhov, Lodeynoye Pole) in 1617-1618 instead of Sweden holding the whole oblast. 74 cells (Noteborg/Shlisselburg, Mga, Kirishi) pass straight on to swedish-ingria (vassal tint) through swedish-ingria/ledger/2 in the same month, and the 13 Kexholm-disc cells were already kexholm-county's. Sweden's 1619 snap falls from 282 removed to 2, and Noteborg stays Swedish in 1619, where the empty patch has it Russian. Caveat: the spec itself includes the Noteborg cell (31.03E 59.94N) and the Kexholm/Priozersk cell, which the page gives to Sweden. The right picture rests on kexholm-county and swedish-ingria running after it (see problems). It also leaves 1 Russian coastal speckle at 29.92E 60.18N in 1617-1618.

Bikaner-state gain 1610 from mughal-empire over the Bikaner 140 km disc: 232 cells (58,700 km2), against the page's 60,391 km2 (text) and 61,355 km2 (infobox). Page: 'The state of Bikaner was founded in 1465'; Kalyan Mal 'acknowledged the suzerainty of Emperor Akbar'; 'Bikaner State became a loyal vassal of the Empire'. The page records no annexation or occupation. Trial: it moves exactly the 97 Mughal-direct cells at the disc's centre, present in the anchors since p1600, to bikaner-state with vassal status under mughal-empire. The other 22 cells are Marwar's overlapping disc. No other year is affected inside the window. 1610 is a repair date, not a page date.

Tsardom-of-russia gain 1618/12 from the Commonwealth of the Chernigov region (Bryansk + Chernihiv + Kursk, 417 cells) minus Cliopatria's 1619 Commonwealth shape: 231 cells, of which Russia holds 216 (Kursk, most of Bryansk). Polish-Russian War page: 'On 11 December 1618 the Truce of Deulino ... gave the Commonwealth control over some of the conquered territories, including the territories of Chernigov and Severia (Siewiersk) and the city of Smolensk'. The Truce of Deulino page names only 'the Smolensk and Chernihiv Voivodeships', neither Kursk nor Bryansk. Trial: it undoes tsardom-of-russia/ledger/49's over-wide handover in the same month. Those 216 cells stay Russian at the end of 1618, where the empty patch has them Commonwealth for one year. 1619 is unchanged (Russia 216, Commonwealth 186). Smolensk is untouched.

Commonwealth loss 1619/1 to Russia over the same 231-cell spec: the companion of events/2 against polish-lithuanian-commonwealth/ledger/20 (gain 1619/1 of the whole Chernigov region). Trial: Russia keeps the 216 cells through 1619, and the Commonwealth's 1619 snap goes from 111 added/274 removed to 256/43. The Truce of Deulino page has both: 'It was signed in the village of Deulino on 11 December 1618 and took effect on 4 January 1619'; 'The Commonwealth gained control over the Smolensk and Chernihiv Voivodeships'.
checks.fix: Source changed to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Truce_of_Deulino and the note rewritten to quote that page's signing and effect dates and its 'Smolensk and Chernihiv Voivodeships'. Region, date and type unchanged. --check-patch re-run: 6 ok.

It matches events/0 and events/2-3, and the Stolbovo quotes check out. It is inert in this compile. Tsardom-of-russia_1612 is Cliopatria 1612-1618, and its 'valid 1612-1616' is prose, so the keyframe of record in 1617-1618 is the union, i.e. the 1612 shape. If the 1612 keyframe were ever cut to 1616, its correction would still put Noteborg and the swedish-ingria strip inside Russia's shape, and the Chernigov-Severia cut would start two years before Deulino.

Ottoman-empire_1612 (Cliopatria 1612-1625) redrawn as the 1612 shape plus country Iraq (1,692 cells). It adds the 688 Iraqi cells the shape lacks (the western desert), which the empty-patch trial leaves unowned from 1612 with no event, after all 1,692 were Ottoman in 1611. Page (Ottoman-Safavid War 1623-1639): 'Baghdad had been since 1621 in the hands of an officer of the Janissaries, the subashi Bakr', who 'returned to Ottoman allegiance'. The Safavids 'besieged Baghdad and took it on 14 January 1624', and 'the Persians soon captured most of Iraq, including the cities of Kirkuk and Mosul' and Najaf and Karbala. It is consistent with p1600-p1609's ottoman-empire_1609 override (all Iraq) and the ledger's 1624/1625 losses. Trial: the 1612 snap goes from 795 removed to 136. Kept-by-others (1,150) and the Ottoman/Safavid conflict (97) are unchanged, so no neighbour loses land. The page does not name the desert, so its extent rests on the neighbouring keyframes.

problems: events/0 depends on order. Ingria in 1617-1619 comes out right (Noteborg Swedish, Tikhvin/Ladoga Russian) only because swedish-ingria/ledger/2 (gain 1617/3 from tsardom-of-russia, Ingria within a box to 32.2E) runs after swedish-empire's events/0 in the same month and takes back the 74 cells events/0 has just returned to Russia. With an empty patch, swedish-empire/ledger/6 takes the whole oblast first, so swedish-ingria never holds land, and Noteborg goes Russian in the 1619 snap. Dossier fix: narrow swedish-empire/ledger/6's region (gazetteer 'Ingria' is all of Leningrad oblast) to Ingria intersected with the Cliopatria Swedish 1619 shape, plus Kexholm. Alternatively, give swedish-ingria/ledger/2 the counterpart swedish-empire. Also check swedish-ingria's polygon, which reaches 32.2E (Kirishi on the Volkhov) beyond the 'Neva basin' its own text describes.

Speckles at the Neva mouth: events/0 adds one Russian cell at 29.92E 60.18N (Sestroretsk coast, outside Cliopatria's coastline) in 1617-1618. Another Russian cell at 30.19E 59.88N is already there without the patch. 30 cells of Leningrad oblast are unowned in 1619 between the Swedish and Russian 1619 shapes (35 with an empty patch).
keyframe_overrides/0 has no effect while tsardom-of-russia_1612 runs 1612-1618 (prose year limits are not parsed). The dossier's own tsardom-of-russia_1617 keyframe is equally inert.

Chernigov-Severia hole, not reported by the window agent: 145 of the 186 cells of Chernigov intersected with Cliopatria's Commonwealth 1619 shape are nobody's from 1612 to the end of 1618, and the Commonwealth holds 41. Deulino cannot hand them over because Russia holds none of them, and PLC ledger/20 (1619/1) takes only Russia's cells. So the 1612-1618 maps show Chernigov-Severia unowned, about 1,000 cell-years, until the Commonwealth's 1619 snap. Suggested patch for the orchestrator: a polish-lithuanian-commonwealth gain 1619/1 (or 1618/12) from nobody over intersect(Chernigov, Cliopatria PLC 1619), source https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Truce_of_Deulino ('gained control over the Smolensk and Chernihiv Voivodeships'). Who held it in 1612-1617 needs a page (the Polish-Russian War page has the Poles capture Kursk in 1616).

Bikaner hole: it starts in p1500-p1599 (the p1500 anchor has all 232 cells Bikaner's, the p1600 anchor 97 Mughal-direct) and persists through p1600-p1609, despite mughal-empire's fx-10 exclusion of Bikaner from the 1526 regions. events/1 repairs it only from 1610, and adds a 'gain' caption in 1610 for no 1610 event. The cause should be traced in the earlier window.

Boundary: keyframe_overrides/1 holds to 1625. In p1620-p1629 the western desert is now Ottoman until the ledger's 1625 'Iraq minus Baghdad' loss hands it to the Safavids. The page names only 'most of Iraq, including ... Kirkuk and Mosul' (and Najaf, Karbala), so the desert's 1625 owner is unsourced. p1620-p1629's ottoman-empire_1626 override assumes the Safavids hold all Iraq outside Baghdad from 1625, which is consistent.
